detail:
Full summary: Task 8 (inline): virtualized faceted list view (js/list-view.js) + orchestrator (js/main.js) + util.js; Blackboard table view replaced — verified in browser at 5k: 23-32 DOM rows for 5000 visible records, 42ms facet filter, day-group headers, detail via /api/blackboard/:id, zero console errors. Legacy renderBlackboard deleted from app.js. Suite 1164 green.
Decisions: Fixed a discovered edge in virtualization during browser verification: filtering while scrolled deep left scrollTop beyond the shrunken content, rendering an empty window — rebuild() now clamps scrollTop to the new max before rendering. Chose clamping over reset-to-top so poll-driven rebuilds don't yank the user's scroll position.; Kept renderBlackboardDetail in app.js (not yet moved) because navigateToId cross-links still render from legacy state — dedupe deferred to Phase 5 routing task, recorded to avoid double-maintenance surprises.; main.js runs its own 5s /api/status poll for store delta detection rather than intercepting app.js's fetchStatus — one duplicate cheap request per tick buys full decoupling from legacy code.
Findings: Discovered need: the Blackboard STREAM view still renders one card per entry (O(dataset) DOM) — plan didn't cover it; folded into Phase 5 cleanup (options: window it onto the shared list or retire it).; Playwright MCP screenshots save relative to repo root (filename param does not accept absolute paths outside allowed roots) — clean up stray .jpeg files before commits.
